description: Header file defining structures, enums, and function prototypes for a line editing library used in terminal interfaces.

methods.name: uline_set_cursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor position within the line buffer, ensuring it does not exceed the buffer length.

methods.name: uline_get_line
methods.description: Retrieves the current line buffer and its length.

methods.name: uline_set_line2_cursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor position in the secondary line buffer, ensuring it does not exceed the buffer length.

methods.name: uline_get_line2
methods.description: Retrieves the secondary line buffer and its length.
